metadataRaw.title: How to Decompress Your UPPER BACK (Between the Shoulder Blades)
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to decompress your upper back (between the shoulder blades) for QUICK pain relief! 

These spinal decompression stretches and exercises are geared towards relieving pressure in the spinal discs of the upper and middle back (thoracic spine). How they work is through pulling motions, or TRACTION. Think of a very good stretch that helps open up the spine.

This is effective in many ways, such as helping to decrease muscle and joint stiffness and taking pressure off pinched nerves that may be causing sharp, shooting pains across the back and shoulder blade area. 

All of these decompression exercises are safe, effective and can be done AT HOME! As a bonus, you may find they give upper back pain relief in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and learn how to decompress your upper back at home! 

CHAPTERS:
0:00 Intro
0:52 Middle of the Night Fix
3:12 Decompress With Soup
